critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the engine primitive geometry on both the left and right wing sections to achieve a total of four engines. For each pair, translate the engine nacelles 15% further outboard along the wing span from the fuselage centerline and rotate the wing root geometry -20 degrees on the Y-axis to establish the required sweep.

discrepancies.observed: Two engines visible under the wing
Engines are positioned far forward and low on the fuselage/wing root
discrepancies.reference: Engines are mounted further outboard along the swept wings
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: move engines outward along wing span

discrepancies.observed: Wings appear relatively straight with minimal backward angle
discrepancies.reference: Significant rearward sweep of the main wings
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: rotate wing geometry backward on Y-axis

discrepancies.observed: Engines are simple cylinders/rectangles without visible nacelle tapering
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: scale and rotate primitive components to taper
